events.summary: Hey folks! events.title: Dressed for the Sentence
events.summary: We spent a long time thinking about how to dress our inmates. We considered options: business formal, casual, maybe something from Gucci. events.title: We've finished work on the PC UI
events.summary: If you played the mobile version of Hoosegow — you won't recognize the game. This is not a port and not a visual refresh. We rethought every screen for monitors and gamepad, and the result is a completely different experience. The game is deeper, more informative, and more intuitive — you now have everything you need to make informed decisions instead of acting on blind luck.The mobile version was built for quick sessions and a small screen.
